views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  session,
  stamp,
  path
FROM form_log
WHERE path IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
views.description:
Task: Count the number of distinct sessions that visited the /regist/input page and then later visited the /regist/confirm page in that order (input visit before confirm visit).
Required outputs: coun
